historical_roads.name: Кунейтра — Дамаск
historical_roads.note: First-class road on the 1958 sheet from Quneitra NE, passing just south of Khan Arnabeh, to the sheet edge (arrow 'Damascus'). Beyond the edge: principal road on the 1953 1:2M map and primary road on the AMS July 1967 briefing map. The route via Sa'sa', Khan ash-Shih and Jdeidat Artouz (towns on the road today) is inferred; small-scale maps only.

historical_roads.name: Кунейтра — Кафр-Наффах — мост Бнот-Яаков — Рош-Пинна
historical_roads.note: First-class road throughout: Customs, Gesher Benot Ya'aqov, Mahanayim. Also primary on the July 1967 AMS map and metalled on the 1944 sheet.

historical_roads.name: Метула — Кирьят-Шмона — долина Хула — Рош-Пинна
historical_roads.note: First-class road along the west edge of the Hula valley.

historical_roads.name: Рош-Пинна — Мигдаль — Тверия
historical_roads.note: First-class road: south from Rosh Pinna, down past Ginosar and Migdal, then along the shore.

historical_roads.name: Рош-Пинна — Цфат
historical_roads.note: Road shown climbing west from Rosh Pinna to Safed. The bends were not traced; the midpoint is approximate.

historical_roads.name: Тверия — Цемах — долина Иордана (юг)
historical_roads.note: First-class road along the SW shore to Tsemah, then south past Ashdot Ya'akov. The last point at the 32.60 edge (towards Gesher) is approximate.

historical_roads.name: Эйн-Гев — Ха-Он — Цемах (восточный берег)
historical_roads.note: Second-class road along the SE shore of the Sea of Galilee. North of Ein Gev there is no road.

historical_roads.name: Цемах — Эль-Хамма
historical_roads.note: All-weather road beside the Yarmuk railway. East of El Hamma along the gorge only the railway is drawn, so no road continues.

historical_roads.name: Фик — Кафр-Хариб — Эль-Хамма
historical_roads.note: Second-class road from Fiq SW past Kafr Harib, then down to the Yarmuk at El Hamma. The 1944 sheet has it as an 'other road'. Winding descent; points every 1–2 km.

historical_roads.name: Бутмия — Джухадар — Хисфин — Эль-Аль — Фик
historical_roads.note: Second-class road leaving the Quneitra–Rafid road near Butmiya. The July 1967 AMS map shows the Quneitra–Fiq axis as a primary road, so it could be upgraded to primary. Class by the July 1967 AMS map (primary on the Quneitra–Fiq axis), closer to the scenario date than the 1958 sheet (second class) — designer decision.

historical_roads.name: Кунейтра — Рафид — Нава — Шейх-Мискин
historical_roads.note: First-class road to the sheet edge (arrow 'Ch. Meskine'). Rafid itself is off the road, about 1 km east. Past the edge: the July 1967 AMS map has a secondary road to Sheikh Miskin, and the 1943 1:50k Cheikh Meskine sheet shows a road leaving Sheikh Miskin towards Nawa. Passing through Nawa is inferred, since Nawa lies on the straight line. Not on the 1953 map. Class by the July 1967 AMS map (secondary to Sheikh Miskin), closer to the scenario date than the 1958 sheet (first class) — designer decision.

historical_roads.name: Кунейтра-Рафидская дорога — Хушния
historical_roads.note: Short spur, partly first class, from the main road near Fazara to Khushniyye. Beyond Khushniyye only dry-weather roads.

historical_roads.name: Кунейтра — Мансура — Айн-эль-Хаджаль — Буката — Масада
historical_roads.note: All-weather road with a second-class stretch near Buq'ata. North–south axis along the eastern Golan.

historical_roads.name: Мансура — Васит
historical_roads.note: First-class road westward from Mansura. It ends at Wasit; further west only tracks down the escarpment.

historical_roads.name: Баниас — Масада — Мадждаль-Шамс
historical_roads.note: Mostly a first-class road. The Mas'ade–Majdal Shams stretch is partly second class.

historical_roads.name: Мадждаль-Шамс — Хадар — Бейт-Джин
historical_roads.note: All-weather road over the southern Hermon slopes to the sheet edge (arrow 'Maz. Beit Jine'). The last point, Mazraat Beit Jinn, is a present-day place and the link from the edge is an assumption. Onward towards Qatana/Damascus not checked.

historical_roads.name: Кирьят-Шмона — Хагошрим — Дафна — Дан
historical_roads.note: Paved road east from Kiryat Shmona. On the 1958 sheet it ends at Dan; on the 1944 sheet it continued to Banias. No link to Banias is traced (border/DMZ, about 2 km gap).

historical_roads.name: Хагошрим — Кфар-Сольд — Шамир — Гонен (восточный край Хулы)
historical_roads.note: Road along the east edge of the Hula valley, mostly red (first/second class). The intermediate bends are approximate.

historical_roads.name: Баниас — Гаджар — граница Ливана
historical_roads.note: First-class road NW from Banias, passing about 1.5 km east of Ghajar, to the sheet edge (arrow 'Chtaura', i.e. towards Hasbaya). The continuation in Lebanon was not traced; it probably joins the Marjayoun/Khiam–Hasbaya road.

historical_roads.name: Метула — Кфар-Кила — Марджаюн
historical_roads.note: The 1958 sheet shows a first-class road from Metula west to Kfar Kila and north to the edge (arrow 'Marjayoun'). The 1953 1:2M map shows Marj 'Uyun on the principal road net. The route via Qlayaa beyond the sheet is an assumption.

historical_roads.name: Метула — Хиям
historical_roads.note: The 1958 sheet shows a first-class road leaving Metula north (arrow 'Chtaura'). That it runs via Khiam to the Hasbaya road at Ibl al-Saqi is an assumption.

historical_roads.name: Марджаюн — Хасбайя
historical_roads.note: Principal road Marj 'Uyun – Rashayya on the 1953 map. At 1:2M only the existence and general direction are certain; the alignment via Ibl al-Saqi is an assumption.

historical_roads.name: (Дамаск) — Кисве — Гхабагхиб — Санамейн — Шейх-Мискин — Даэль — Дераа
historical_roads.note: Principal road on the 1953 map (Kiswah, Ghabaghib, As Sanamayn, Shaykh Miskin, Dar'a). Primary on the July 1967 AMS map. The 1943 1:50k Cheikh Meskine sheet shows the Sheikh Miskin–Ibta'–Da'el–south stretch. Alignment between towns is straight-line; the north end at 33.45 and the Atman waypoint are approximate.

historical_roads.name: Шейх-Мискин — Изра
historical_roads.note: Principal road on the 1953 map, continuing east towards As Suwayda. Secondary on the July 1967 AMS map.

historical_roads.name: Даэль — Тафас — Музейриб
historical_roads.note: Roads Da'el–Tafas–Mzairib on the 1943 sheet; not on the small-scale 1953 and 1967 maps. Status in 1967 not confirmed.

historical_roads.name: Дорога Тэплайн (вдоль нефтепровода): Гаджар — Баниас — Васит — Кафр-Наффах — Хушния — Джухадар
historical_roads.note: ASSUMPTION. The pipeline (built about 1950) is on the 1953 and July 1967 small-scale maps, but the road itself is on none of the maps checked; the 1958 sheet does not show the pipeline. Text source (English Wikipedia, 'Petroleum Road'): in 1967 a dirt service road ran beside the pipeline, paved and fenced after 1969. Waypoints come from the present-day road's junctions (Ghajar, Banias Hwy 99, Revaya/Wasit, Nafah, Keshet/Hushniya, Orha near Joukhadar), ±1–2 km. A dirt road, so poor going. Designer decision: kept; a dirt road (track) until 1969.

historical_roads.name: Шоссе Тэплайн (вдоль нефтепровода): Гаджар — Баниас — Васит — Кафр-Наффах — Хушния — Джухадар
historical_roads.note: Paved and fenced after 1969 (English Wikipedia, 'Petroleum Road'); designer decision: a road from 1970. Same alignment as the track.
